title: Software Engineering Intern - Frontend (React / TypeScript)
description:
Exciting internship opportunity for 2025/2026 graduating students and freshers! 0-1 years experience.

About the Role:
Join our UI team to craft responsive interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Mandatory Requirements:
- Fresher or final year student in CS/IT.
- Good understanding of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and CSS/HTML.
- Knowledge of Git and GitHub.

Bonus Points:
- Experience with Next.js or Vite.
- Personal projects hosted on Vercel or Netlify.
